TABE Scores to Enroll

Reading
520

Minimum TABE scale score

BEOC uses the TABE (Test of Adult Basic Education) to place students, and BEOC sets the minimum score for Office Administrative Professional.

Below the score? That is not a no. BEOC can help you find next steps, such as retesting or academic support.

Recommended Learning Path

1

Start with Technology Foundations

Build core computer skills before touching office software.

2

Master Office Productivity Applications

Learn Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Access, and Google Workspace for daily professional use.

3

Learn to Manage Office Data

Develop data organization and database skills.

4

Apply Skills in Modern Office Operations

Use real tools: email, scheduling, CRM, and AI in the workplace.

5

Certify & Launch Your Career

Complete certification prep and enter the workforce ready.
